name: java-angular-debian
onCreateCommand: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl bash git unzip gnupg2 ca-certificates openjdk-17-jdk && curl -fsSL https://dlcdn.apache.org/maven/maven-3/${MAVEN_VERSION}/binaries/apache-maven-${MAVEN_VERSION}-bin.tar.gz | tar -xz -C /opt && ln -s /opt/apache-maven-${MAVEN_VERSION}/bin/mvn /usr/bin/mvn && curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_${NODE_VERSION}.x | bash - && apt-get install -y nodejs && npm install -g npm @angular/cli
